text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, City's new lipstick is out.
Lemme try it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"My new release, you say... Oh, the one from the commercial.
It's a tint, but it has a semi-matte finish.
I think you'd like it."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~... By the way, what should I do
when I want that ultra-glossy look☆?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Falco-senpai, that new product over there might suit you better.
It's waterproof, so it looks great on stage and won't come off with sweat.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~, City-san-approved cosmetics!
If I put this on, will I become a 'city girl' too...!?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wow, Yukino-chan's eyes are sparkling~♪
Curren wants to sparkle together with you, too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
City-san, please make Curren and the others
extra super-duper cute too♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, that subtle charm of Curren's really is amazing.
I'm so jealous."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I'll pick one out for you.
What kind of occasions are you two looking to wear this lipstick for?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the lively, bouncing voices of Umamusume
could be heard echoing from the cosmetics shop.
